The task is complete. I created formulas in J2:J4 that correctly handle all three cases:
- J2 = "Yes" (H2 is a date)
- J3 = "Yes" (H3 = "Yes")
- J4 = "N/A" (H4 = "N/A")

The formula `=IF(ISNUMBER(H{r}),"Yes",IF(H{r}="N/A","N/A",IF(H{r}="Yes","Yes","No")))` checks if H is a date/number first, then "N/A", then "Yes", and defaults to "No" for blank.
